offering_description.value: Develops residential communities and sells finished homesites to builders and homebuyers. Operates hotels, clubs, golf courses and marinas for guests and members. Develops and leases commercial space and apartments and sells commercial land.

primary_services.value: hotel stays; private club memberships; golf and marina operations; commercial property leasing; apartment leasing

customer_segment.value: B2B: homebuilders, commercial developers, retailers and office tenants; B2C: homebuyers, hotel guests, club members, golfers, boaters and apartment renters

end_markets.value: residential housing; tourism and lodging; leisure and recreation; commercial real estate

revenue_model.value: product sales: residential homesites and commercial land parcels; service fees: hotel stays, dining, golf and marina services; subscription: recurring private club dues; rental or leasing: apartments, retail space and offices
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; subscription; rental or leasing

value_chain_position.value: other: improves land with roads and utilities, then sells parcels to builders and commercial developers; asset operator: operates hotels, clubs, golf courses and marinas for guests and members, and leases properties to households and businesses

geography_served.value: US regional: Northwest Florida, primarily Bay and Walton counties

specialization.value: related lines: residential land development, hospitality and recreation, commercial development and property leasing

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: homesite sales to builders and leasing through property teams; own locations: hotels, clubs, golf courses and marinas; online: hotel websites and travel booking platforms; agents / brokers: residential real estate agents and commercial property brokers
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; own locations; online; agents / brokers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: local zoning and building permits, state and federal wetlands and stormwater rules, and hospitality health and safety standards
